data.title: Anemone: one sensor, one aperture, a small body
data.body: Build a separate Raspberry Pi experiment with one ambient temperature sensor, seven damped coupled modes, OPEN/CLOSE as the only physical action, an unlabeled energy picture, at most twelve carry tokens and a pinned local model. Mike intends the hostname anemone; the Pi is currently unplugged. Children: d-anemone-protocol, t-anemone-replay, c-anemone-device, t-anemone-pilot, t-anemone-picture-regulation, t-anemone-prediction-carry, t-anemone-rhythm-order, t-anemone-longitudinal. Finish when the qualified device, auditable pilot, controlled comparisons and synthesis exist, including negative results. Reuse Avado/ICP operating lessons; do not inherit their multi-input body, speech feedback or 68% controller. Planning complete; implementation and experiments unrun.
data.source: Mike's Anemone proposal, September 6, 2026; prior Avado/ICP documentation

data.title: Anemone: freeze dynamics, prompt and forecast protocol
data.body: Parent: d-anemone. Depends on: none; can start before the Pi is connected. Specify seven two-component damped modes, fixed energy scaling, wall-time/gap semantics, fixed OPEN gain, the unlabeled picture, minimal procedural contract, tokenizer-counted carry and independent field validation. One glyph predicts the next column's aggregate energy; scores stay observer-only. Finish with versioned equations/configuration, sample exact prompt/output, timing/deadline and analysis plan. Explicitly retain the deviations from the original sketch and schedule controls for rhythm claims. Freeze stages: provisional protocol/schema before replay; calibrated sensor/glyph scales and OPEN gain after the pilot, before evaluation. Bound total response to the proposed 128 tokens; commit only at whole-response completion before deadline and reject late results.
data.source: Mike's Anemone proposal, September 6, 2026; prior Avado/ICP documentation

data.title: Anemone: prove sensor admission, memory and replay offline
data.body: Parent: d-anemone. Depends on: d-anemone-protocol. Build the isolated simulator/replay path and observer records with scripted sensor inputs and aperture policies. Prove a known perturbation enters under OPEN and is absent under CLOSE, residual state decays, the energy picture retains the tested history, and restart/gap replay agrees within declared tolerance. Finish with reproducible fixtures, a full sample record and measured pass/fail results; revise the observable before freezing if phase information disappears. No existing live systems are involved.

data.title: Anemone: qualify the Pi, temperature sensor and local model
data.body: Parent: d-anemone. Physical blocker: Pi is unplugged; unpark when Mike powers/connects it and access is available. Exact model, RAM, storage, OS and sensor are unknown. Inventory first, establish the intended anemone hostname/verified SSH endpoint, adapt prior Avado/ICP discovery and model benchmarks, and test ambient sensor isolation from inference heating. Depends on d-anemone-protocol for exact-contract model qualification. Finish with at least 100 benchmark calls, >=99% valid action/forecast, p95 <=120 seconds, no overlap/OOM/sustained swapping, recorded thermals and power state, and explicit selected model/runtime identity. A roughly 4B model is a candidate; smaller candidates are separate benchmark runs.

data.title: Anemone: run an auditable 72-hour pilot
data.body: Parent: d-anemone. Depends on: t-anemone-replay and c-anemone-device. Run scripted OPEN/CLOSE, an overnight close, controlled dropout and restart checks with sensor/body/model processes separated. Finish when every scheduled opportunity is recorded, >=99% expected readings outside declared faults are valid, body time progresses during sleep/inference, state restores and replays, and no generated prose or observer scores enter the body or future prompts. Exclude pilot/calibration data from evaluation and distinguish authored actions from scheduler/failure closures. Keep a continuous 600-second bin grid, with overnight bins marked voice_not_scheduled. Freeze final calibrated scales/gain before evaluation.

data.title: Anemone: test picture dependence and spontaneous regulation
data.body: Parent: d-anemone. Depends on: t-anemone-pilot and frozen analysis plan. Compare intact, withheld and matched shuffled pictures with carry/bar/history/backend controlled, then validate in closed-loop trials. Measure chosen closure versus fixed body saturation and trajectory effects against always-open/closed, timer, matched random and threshold policies; include opaque action symbols. Finish with effects, uncertainty, sample/failure counts and temporal-null assumptions. Forced sleep/failure closure never counts as chosen homeostasis. Test completion does not require a positive result.

data.title: Anemone: test forecast usefulness and twelve-token carry
data.body: Parent: d-anemone. Depends on: t-anemone-pilot and frozen analysis plan. Compare intact/empty/shuffled carry and one-glyph forecasts with persistence, constant/action-conditioned decay and simple temperature-plus-dynamics predictors on matched held-out histories. Report ordinal error, exact matches, coverage and OPEN/CLOSE/latency strata. Explore carry clusters only with held-out day validation and weather/schedule controls. Finish with replicated comparisons and explicit limits; logged scoring is not model training and easier closed-state predictions are not evidence of better world forecasting.

data.title: Anemone: test masked-input rhythm and order beyond timers
data.body: Parent: d-anemone. Depends on: t-anemone-replay and frozen analysis; real-temperature transfer also needs t-anemone-pilot. In isolated replay remove nightly forced closure and voice silence, use uniform calls, controlled carry and no time labels, then mask sensor after shifted temperature histories. Compare reset/unentrained states, multiple initial phases, clock-only controls, and several candidate cycles. Swap warm-day order with matched present input/terminal segment; compare leaky smoothers, timer, random and memoryless controls. Finish with evidence separating retention from supplied schedule, programmed periods, passive transient and ordinary smoothing.

data.body: Parent: d-anemone. Depends on: t-anemone-pilot and preregistered analysis. Run a proposed four-week block with frozen configuration/model and complete missingness/failure records; coordinate the three experiment cards' controls. Finish with archived denominators, uncertainty, held-out comparisons, replication limits and a synthesis linked to the Astrid/minime research questions. Four weeks is a planning duration, not proof of statistical power. Mark tests done for useful null results; create verified finding cards only for supported specific claims.
